propositions.name: ether_exists_as_medium
propositions.statement: The æther exists as a medium through which matter can move and which mediates intermolecular forces.
propositions.quote: This suggestion of the "contraction" hypothesis by Lorentz, from considerations in regard to intermolecular forces analogous to the interaction, through the mediation of the æther, of electric and magnetic forces

propositions.name: earth_moves_through_ether
propositions.statement: The earth is in motion through the æther and this motion could in principle produce double refraction in the water.
propositions.quote: Hence, we may conclude that to this order of sensibility there is no double refraction in the water due to its motion through the æther.

propositions.name: definite_direction_earths_motion
propositions.statement: The earth's orbital motion has a definite direction with respect to which the plane of polarization can be set at 45°.
propositions.quote: the one, a system rotating about a vertical axis, the other a similar system rotating about a horizontal axis so as to shift the plane of polarization from a position at 45° to the earth's orbital motion through an angle of 90°

propositions.name: orbital_and_light_velocities_definite
propositions.statement: The orbital velocity and the light-velocity each have definite values used in calculating the expected effect.
propositions.quote: or about 1600 times greater than the smallest effect which could be observed.

propositions.name: rotating_trough_changes_position_relative_to_ether
propositions.statement: Rotating the trough through 90° brings the optical path from the meridian into the direction of the earth's orbital motion.
propositions.quote: A match was obtained with, say, the trough in the meridian at noon, this was then turned through 90° into the direction of the earth's orbital motion.

propositions.name: orbital_and_solar_velocities_conspire
propositions.statement: The earth's orbital velocity and the velocity of the solar system in space conspire to give the earth's net velocity through the æther.
propositions.quote: These experiments were repeated during the early part of February, 1904, when the earth's orbital velocity conspires approximately with that of the solar system in space.

propositions.name: null_result_across_positions
propositions.statement: The absence of any change in the compensator match as the trough is rotated indicates no double refraction due to motion through the æther.
propositions.quote: In no case could a change be observed, i.e. there was still a match indicating no double refraction.

propositions.name: match_transferable_between_positions
propositions.statement: A compensator match obtained in one position of the trough remains a valid reference for observations made in another position.
propositions.quote: The entire system was mounted on a common base, so that once a match was obtained it could be moved without disturbing it.

propositions.name: contraction_would_produce_double_refraction
propositions.statement: A contraction of the matter in the direction of motion would produce observable double refraction in the water or glass.
propositions.quote: If in the movement of matter through æther an increase in density in this direction took place, producing a change in the natural frequency of the molecular systems similar to that which occurs in glass

propositions.name: density_change_alters_index
propositions.statement: An increase in density produces a proportional increment in the excess of the index above unity.
propositions.quote: Mascart has shown that in the case of water under compression the increment in the excess of the index above unity is nearly proportional to the increment of its density.

propositions.name: strain_calibrates_expected_effect
propositions.statement: The relative retardation produced in glass by a known weight and width calibrates the sensibility for the ether-motion effect.
propositions.quote: From this can be calculated the relative retardation produced in glass per unit weight and unit width.

propositions.name: path_length_same_in_every_position
propositions.statement: The path of the light through the water is the same length whatever the position of the trough.
propositions.quote: sunlight was so thrown into the trough as to keep its path the same whatever its position

propositions.name: magnetic_rotation_reversed_for_observer_moving_with_trough
propositions.statement: A magnetic-field rotation of the plane of polarization would be reversed with respect to an observer moving with the trough, so it cannot mask an ether-motion effect.
propositions.quote: since the rotation due to a magnetic field is always in a definite direction and independent of the direction of the ray, such a rotation of the plane of polarization would be reversed with respect to an observer moving with the trough

propositions.name: contraction_magnitude_v2_over_2V2
propositions.statement: The change expected on the contraction hypothesis is of order v squared over 2 V squared, seven times greater than the observed limit in glass.
propositions.quote: which is seven times smaller than that expected on the "contraction" hypothesis.

propositions.name: poisson_ratio_gives_transverse_change
propositions.statement: A contraction along the direction of drift is accompanied by a change at right angles related by Poisson's ratio.
propositions.quote: If we correct by ¼ for Poisson's ratio, as we should if the interference problem were done on a glass support, the calculated contraction becomes

propositions.name: null_dichotomy_conclusion
propositions.statement: The negative result implies either that the æther moves with the embedded matter or that the relative motion produces very little change in intermolecular forces and dimensions.
propositions.quote: we also conclude either that the aether moves with the embedded matter, or that the effect of the relative motion on the intermolecular forces and the possible consequent relative change in dimensions are very small

propositions.name: intermolecular_forces_mediated_by_ether
propositions.statement: Intermolecular forces are through the mediation of the æther, analogous to the interaction of electric and magnetic forces.
propositions.quote: from considerations in regard to intermolecular forces analogous to the interaction, through the mediation of the æther, of electric and magnetic forces

propositions.name: number_of_waves_from_path_index_wavelength
propositions.statement: The number of waves of light in the path equals the path length times the index divided by the wavelength.
propositions.quote: The total path of the light in the water was 2856 cms. Taking its index as 1.33, the number of waves is

propositions.name: sensibility_valid_in_all_positions
propositions.statement: The sensibility of the compensator determined in one setting applies unchanged when the trough is turned into any other position.
propositions.quote: Under the most favourable conditions a rotation of the compensator of 0°.2 approximately could be detected.

propositions.name: limit_on_difference_in_velocity_or_index
propositions.statement: The observed limit on retardation gives the greatest difference in velocity or in index between the two components which could exist in the medium.
propositions.quote: This represents the greatest difference in velocity or in index between the two components which could exist referred to that of water for green light

propositions.name: observer_moves_with_trough_without_disturbing_optics
propositions.statement: The observer can move with the trough so that the observer's motion does not disturb the optical measurement.
propositions.quote: a seat was mounted so that the observer could move undisturbed with the trough, the head being steadied by means of a clamp

propositions.name: different_times_give_different_ether_directions
propositions.statement: Observations made at noon and at 6 P.M. correspond to different directions of the earth's motion through the æther.
propositions.quote: Observations were made at noon and at 6 P. M. in the early part of December.

propositions.name: rotation_180_reverses_direction
propositions.statement: Rotating the trough through 180° into the meridian reverses the direction of the arrangement with respect to any fixed direction in space.
propositions.quote: To make sure of this the trough was rotated through 180° into the meridian so as to reverse the direction: but no effect could be observed.

propositions.name: density_change_alters_natural_frequency
propositions.statement: A change in density in the direction of motion produces a change in the natural frequency of the molecular systems, and hence in the index.
propositions.quote: producing a change in the natural frequency of the molecular systems similar to that which occurs in glass, say, then, to determine how great it might be from these results

propositions.name: contraction_and_elongation_give_same_double_refraction
propositions.statement: Whether the theory predicts contraction along drift, elongation along drift, or extension at right angles, the effect observed by double refraction would be the same.
propositions.quote: the effect to be observed by means of double refraction in the preceding experiments would be the same

propositions.name: matter_has_definite_motion_through_ether
propositions.statement: There is a definite fact of the matter about whether the water is moving through the æther and about the direction of that motion.
propositions.quote: no double refraction in the water due to its motion through the æther

propositions.name: michelson_morley_null_motivates_contraction
propositions.statement: The FitzGerald-Lorentz contraction hypothesis was proposed to explain the negative results of the Michelson-Morley experiment on interference between two rays at right angles and parallel to the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: The FitzGerald-Lorentz "Contraction" Hypothesis to explain the negative results of the Michelson-Morley experiment of interference between two rays, at right angles and parallel to the earth's motion, has been tested by Rayleigh
